name: coastal

copywriting_tone.style: Warm, atmospheric, experience-led. Evocative language. Invite the reader in. Never pushy.

examples.hero_tagline: Designed for life on the water.
examples.about_opener: We've been part of this waterfront community for years — built on local knowledge and a love for the sea.
examples.trust_language: Family owned. Locally rooted. Trusted by the community.
examples.emergency: On-call for urgent marine service needs.

layout_variant.hero_style: Full-bleed or airy. Large photography if available. Soft text overlay. Subdued CTA styling.
layout_variant.nav_style: Clean. Transparent feel. Serif brand name. Light background.
layout_variant.cta_style: Ocean blue. Soft language. No urgency.
layout_variant.gallery_style: Full-bleed masonry or horizontal scroll. Image-led. Landscape aspect ratios.
layout_variant.review_style: Elegant blockquote. Subtle left border. Minimal star decoration.
layout_variant.spacing: Airy. Wide section padding. Generous breathing room.
layout_variant.typography: Italic serif display. Light Inter body. Generous line height.

layout_notes: Photography-forward. Gallery leads content. Story before services. Relaxed pacing conveys premium atmosphere.
